def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = {v: [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, x in enumerate(row) if x == v] for v in (1, 2)}
    (r, c), = points[1]
    (tr, tc), = points[2]
    sr = (tr > r) - (tr < r)
    sc = (tc > c) - (tc < c)
    # Draw a diagonal from marker 1 toward marker 2, then continue along
    # the remaining axis, stopping diagonally adjacent to marker 2.
    while abs(tr-r) > 1 and abs(tc-c) > 1:
        r += sr
        c += sc
        out[r][c] = 3
    while abs(tr-r) > 1:
        r += sr
        out[r][c] = 3
    while abs(tc-c) > 1:
        c += sc
        out[r][c] = 3
    return out
PY
